fields.label: Farm
fields.description: The farm, from Upande Core's own Farm list. One row per farm this project works -- adding a row does not hide the others unless "Only work the Farms listed below" is ticked.

fields.label: Area (HA)
fields.description: The farm's own area. Field intelligence divides by this, so it is a property of the farm rather than a sum of whatever blocks were worked.

fields.label: Cost Project
fields.description:
The project whose Tasks are this farm's plannable activities. This is the one thing this app knows about a farm that Upande Core does not track, so it lives here rather than on the Farm record.

Every activity a master plan can budget for this farm comes from this project's Task list, with each task's rate. So pick the project that holds the field activities -- on Kaitet those are "Kaitet Avocado Tasks" and "Kaitet Coffee Tasks", not a one-off job like a greenhouse build or an employee separation, which also have Tasks but are not things anybody plans a week's labour against.

Leave this empty and the Master Plan screen says the farm has no cost project and offers no activities.

fields.label: Approver Role
fields.description: Superseded by Stage Approvers in Settings, which names both the role and the people. Read-only, and removed in the next release.
